extracted.intended_audience: readers and researchers looking for a 1922 edition of Aristotle's Poetics on the Internet Archive
extracted.subtask_description: An Internet Archive catalog/item page providing metadata, access (download/stream) options, and content-moderation flag categories for the 1922 Macmillan edition of Aristotle's Poetics (Butcher edition). Useful for locating and retrieving the digitized book and reviewing its bibliographic details.

rubrics_metrics.name: Content flagging categories
rubrics_metrics.description: Reasons listed for flagging this item: Graphic Violence; Explicit Sexual Content; Hate Speech; Misinformation/Disinformation; Marketing/Phishing/Advertising; Misleading/Inaccurate/Missing Metadata.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The page presents these discrete categories as the selectable reasons users may use to flag the item for review; no additional scoring guidance or examples are provided on-page.
